name: api_studio_agent_directive
_description: ADDENDUM 2 Bloque 4.1 backend - POST /api/v1/studio/agent/directive. El arquitecto pulsa 'Aplicar como directiva' en el chat con un agente concreto. Persiste en architect_directives + activity_log. Multi-tenant via JWT.
_status: B72-fase-G+ ADDENDUM 2 Bloque 4 (backend only, UI pospuesta)
_body_shape: { agent_name: string, project_id: uuid|null, directive: string (max 1500), type: 'correction'|'question'|'instruction'|'pause' }

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO architect_directives (tenant_id, agent_name, project_id, directive_text, directiva, directive_type, source, created_by, categoria)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3::uuid, $4, $4, $5, 'chat', $6::uuid, 'comunicacion_cliente')
RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.tenant_id, $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.agent_name, $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.project_id, $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.directive_text, $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.directive_type, $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.user_id] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO activity_log (tenant_id, project_id, agent_name, action, message_type, from_agent, to_agent, output_summary, status)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3, $4, 'directive', 'architect', $3, $5, 'success')

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.tenant_id, $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.project_id, $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.agent_name, 'El arquitecto me ha pedido: ' + $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.directive_short, $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.directive_text.slice(0, 500)] }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, data: { directive_id: $('Insert Directive').first().json.id, agent_name: $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.agent_name, project_id: $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.project_id, directive_type: $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.directive_type }, meta: { request_id: $('Decode JWT + Validate').first().json.request_id } }) }}
